purpose: Evidence for a CPU-lab embedding uplift evaluation for the szl-second-brain RAG lane. Measures whether the Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B class (GGUF, llama.cpp-native) beats the estate's current pinned embedding artifact on estate-held-out retrieval queries — without any production change.

governing_boundary.rule: Outputs of any run under this contract are proposal/evidence only. Upstream benchmark claims (including any MTEB figures on model cards) are not local measurements. Silent substitution is forbidden.

baseline.identity: REQUIRED_AT_EXECUTION (owner pins the current second-brain embedding artifact + revision)
baseline.note: The baseline is the estate's own production embedding path; it is pinned at execution so the comparison is honest and reproducible.

inspected_2026_09_08.format: GGUF (Q8 + imatrix), llama.cpp and Ollama loadable
inspected_2026_09_08.note: 0.6B class — CPU-lab native; the estate's llama.cpp stack loads it without new dependencies.

execution_envelope.environment: house CPU lab via llama.cpp embedding endpoint or the harness instrumented-wrapper mode (recorded commands)
execution_envelope.harness: harnesses/research-evidence/cpu_evidence_harness.py — probe mode (recorded command per measurement rung)

measurements_required.definition: recall@k (k in [1,5,10]) on an estate-held-out query set drawn from the second-brain corpus; identical queries, identical k, both artifacts
measurements_required.label: MEASURED on estate corpus only; never report upstream MTEB as estate evidence

measurements_required.definition: texts/second at fixed batch and document length distribution, both artifacts, same hardware
measurements_required.label: MEASURED

measurements_required.definition: Peak RSS and cold-load time for both artifacts
measurements_required.label: MEASURED

gate_thresholds.recall_rule: candidate recall@5 >= baseline recall@5 (parity or better; regression is an automatic park)
gate_thresholds.note: Thresholds authorize writing an integration proposal for the second-brain lane only. They do not select, promote, or ship.

non_goals: No Hugging Face repository is created, overwritten, or retagged by this contract
No held frontier choice is promoted or ungated
No production RAG change is authorized
No upstream leaderboard figure may be quoted as a local measurement

receipt_requirement.signing_note: Receipts emit under current signing posture; HMAC PLACEHOLDER labeling applies until A11OY_HMAC_KEY is set, per HONEST_DISCLOSURE.md

provenance.radar: frontier-radar-2026-09-08 (second pass, lane coverage completion: second-brain/embedding lane)
